==English==

===Etymology===
{{root|en|ine-pro|*steh₂-}}
From {{der|en|la|stationarius}}, from {{m|la|statio}}, ultimately from {{m|la|stō||to stand}}. {{doublet|en|stationer}}. Equivalent to {{suffix|en|station|ary}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈsteɪʃ(ə)n(ə)ɹi/|a=UK}}
** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-stationary.wav|a=Southern England}}
* {{enPR|stāʹshə-nĕr'ē|a=US}}, {{IPA|en|/ˈsteɪʃəˌnɛɹi/}}
* {{homophones|en|stationery}}
* {{hyph|en|sta|tion|ary}}

===Adjective===
{{wp}}
{{en-adj|-}}

# Not [[moving]].
#: {{syn|en|fixed|immobile|motionless|still|stock-still|unmoving|Thesaurus:stationary}}
#: {{ant|en|in motion|moving|on the move|Thesaurus:in motion}}
#: {{ux|en|The train remained '''stationary''' for a few moments, before lurching forward along the track.}}
# [[incapable|Incapable]] of being moved.
#: {{syn|en|immobile|unmoveable|Thesaurus:immobile}}
#: {{ant|en|mobile|moveable|Thesaurus:movable}}
# [[unchanging|Unchanging]].
#: {{syn|en|changeless|constant|immutable|unchanging|Thesaurus:changeless}}
#: {{ant|en|changing|mutable|variable|Thesaurus:changeable}}
# {{lb|en|mathematics}} A [[set]] which [[intersect]]s all [[club]] sets.
